﻿Foltyn GTA Clipper Guide
Content: CHANNEL
ANY NEW GTA 6 VIDEOS UPLOADED TO FOLTYN’S YOUTUBE. (NO GTA 5)


DO
* Must TAG Foltyn on ALL POSTS (first line)
* IG: @realfoltyn
* YT: @FoltynFamily 
* TT: @klfoltyn
* ALL CLIPS MUST REACH MINIMUM 0.75% Engagement to be Approved


DON’T
* NO NEGATIVITY TOWARD FOLTYN
* DO NOT STORY SHARE OR COLLAB POST
* DO NOT post to accounts with low engagement 
* DO NOT use external logos on posts
(i.e. stake, rainbet, kalshi, etc.)
* DO NOT repeat post the same clips/ low effort submissions
   * No stealing clips from others
   * No stealing captions (this includes rewording) - if using the same clip you must edit and have a unique caption




Mandatory Clipper Guidelines for ALL CAMPAIGNS

* No low quality, rushed posts 
   * This includes but is not limited to poor audio quality, poor video quality. (quality>quantity)
* NO STEALING POSTS
   * Posts taken from other users will be denied
* REVIEW CONTENT PROVIDED
   * If you have been provided with a cut down of content, this does not mean it is ready to post - we simply cut down content to prevent you from watching multiple hours of footage.
   * You must ensure content provided meets guidelines of the campaign, this could be cursing, hiding logos or other
